title: Restore substantial scalp hair in severe alopecia areata with systemic treatment

concept.text: Reverse extensive autoimmune hair loss through an approved systemic medicine. JAK-pathway treatment achieved clinically substantial regrowth in a subset of patients, without establishing permanent immune tolerance. Proposed completion test: FDA approval supported by randomized trials in patients with at least 50% scalp hair loss, demonstrating superiority to placebo in achieving SALT ≤20, equivalent to at least 80% scalp hair coverage. Test set by: FDA; the baricitinib trials evaluated the SALT ≤20 endpoint at week 36. Reported achieved: FDA approved baricitinib (Olumiant) for adults with severe alopecia areata on 13 June 2022. Overlaps: DER-03, IMM-04. Sources given: [FDA announcement of first systemic alopecia areata treatment](https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/USFDA/bulletins/31bfc85) ; [FDA review describing the alopecia treatment landscape](https://www.fda.gov/media/172964/download?attachment=).
